integrity: Proof and finite numerical cross-checks are supplied. Theoretical asymptotics are analytic, not inferred from finite samples. Independent mathematical audit and independent novelty determination have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-area nondegenerate isosceles trapezoids with parameter strictly between zero and one; real angular frequencies; distinct zeros only. No uniform parameter-edge estimates, complex zero classification, or multiplicity assertions.
title: A Thomae law for the asymptotic Fourier-null density of isosceles trapezoids
